Each pair of distinct circles meets in at most 2 points. With 4 circles there are C(4,2) = 6 pairs, so there are at most 6 × 2 = 12 intersection points.

This bound can be reached. Choose four circles in general position so that every pair crosses at two points and no three circles pass through a common point. Then all 12 points are distinct.

ANSWER: 12
